name: Wedlock
overview: Scripture affirms the sanctity and honor of marriage as the God-ordained union where a man and woman become one flesh, leaving their parents to establish a new family (Genesis 2:24). Finding a wife is described as a good and blessed thing, receiving favor from the Lord (Proverbs 18:22). The New Testament warns against divorce except in cases of fornication, emphasizing the seriousness of marital fidelity and condemning adultery (Matthew 5:32). Marriage is presented as honorable and pure, contrasting with the judgment reserved for immoral relationships outside wedlock (Hebrews 13:4). These verses collectively underscore the biblical ideal of wedlock as a holy covenant designed for lifelong commitment and purity.
